name: Reuben
summary: Jacob's firstborn son, born to Leah. He tried to save Joseph when the brothers planned to kill him, but Jacob said he would not excel because he had defiled his father's bed.

key_moments.title: Lies with His Father's Concubine
key_moments.description: While Israel lived beyond the tower of Edar, Reuben lay with Bilhah, his father's concubine, and Israel heard about it.

key_moments.title: Trying to Save Joseph
key_moments.description: When his brothers plotted to kill Joseph, Reuben talked them into throwing him into a pit instead, planning to bring him back to their father. When Reuben returned and found the pit empty, he tore his clothes.

key_moments.title: Pledging His Sons
key_moments.description: In Egypt, Reuben reminded his brothers that he had warned them not to harm Joseph. Back home, he offered his own two sons to Jacob as a pledge that he would bring Benjamin back.

key_moments.title: Rebuked in Jacob's Last Words
key_moments.description: Jacob called Reuben his firstborn and the beginning of his strength. But he said Reuben was unstable as water and would not excel, because he had gone up to his father's bed.
